en.does_not_prove: It does not show that every line was written with the same phone settings; an export that mixes day-first and month-first dates stops with an error instead of being converted.
en.shows: Numeric dates were read as dmy: line 5 ("13/03/2026, 08:45") can only be read that way.
en.title: Date order inferred from the export

en.does_not_prove: It does not show that the phone was set to Europe/Paris; a wrong zone shifts every time by the same amount.
en.shows: The export's times carry no UTC offset; they were read as Europe/Paris and stored in UTC. The original text of each time is kept in the event's custom field source_time.
en.title: Local times converted with the examiner's time zone

en.does_not_prove: It does not show whether any messages were deleted.
en.shows: WhatsApp exports leave out messages deleted before the export; the RSMF can only contain what the export contains.
en.title: Deleted messages are not exported
